label: critic-recheck
statement: I read only reviews/critic-corrections.json for this targeted recheck. No quarantine file was read. I retained the original critic report and did not reread the broad samples, repository files, raw maps, books, external sources, or use subagents.

findings.assessment: The typed effect now activates every selected source together and interleaves arriving messages. present-input-count describes how many sources are present; it is no longer an active-source cap. The pending queue and adjustable concurrency policy are absent. This resolves the identified mismatch while retaining an observable channel.policy toy effect.
The generic purpose-setting analog has been omitted and the background classification retained. The row no longer asserts the unsupported strange-loop correspondence.

Both rows remain explicitly untyped. Operating system now names resource owners, waiting tasks and protection refusals with corresponding metrics. Composition of procedures now names calls and returns, input/output contract satisfaction and dependency paths with corresponding metrics. These distinguish the concepts and preserve the useful existing analogs without claiming implemented effects.
The title now limits its claim to no manual unsubscribe after normal completion. This removes the prior unrestricted claim about finite streams while retaining background status.

limitations: This is a targeted review of five corrected rows against four original findings, not a new broad catalog review or runtime execution test.
The parent reported that official installed RxJS source confirms mergeWith has no concurrency parameter; I did not independently read that source during this restricted recheck.
